shots.visual: POV walks into a warm yellow kitchen; the rice cooker in the center of the frame is steaming. DeepSeek Whale Maiden (blue and white gradient ponytail, whale fin accessory, loose DeepSeek T-shirt, barefoot) stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, shoveling a ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks; her cheeks puff out like a hamster's.

camera.move: slow walk-in from the doorway, slight head bob

shots.lighting: warm yellow practical light; she is the cool blue-white accent; background softly blurred
shots.character_action: keeps chewing hard; tilts her head slightly at the footsteps but does not turn around
shots.expression: eyes closed in bliss, cheeks fully puffed

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: (chewing: ba-jie ba-jie)... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Take another bite for sampling--

sfx.texture: close reverb matching the POV distance

shots.transition: hard cut on the first table tap

shots.visual: POV freezes. The owner's hand enters from the right edge of the frame and taps the dining table twice. DeepSeek Whale Maiden freezes mid-bite, chopsticks suspended in the air, then slowly turns her head toward the lens with rice still in her mouth.

camera.move: locked off, POV hand enters frame right

shots.lighting: same warm kitchen light; the highlights in her eyes turn into rotating circles
shots.character_action: whole body freezes; slow robotic head turn toward the camera
shots.expression: pupils trembling, spiral highlights in her eyes, mouth full and unmoving

sfx.cue: two crisp taps on the table: dong, dong

shots.visual: DeepSeek Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth at 1.5x speed; rice grains fly and splash onto the lens; her cheeks bulge to the limit and rice grains catch in her T-shirt collar while her eyes plead with you.

camera.move: slight handheld shake, drifting back as the owner retreats

shots.lighting: warm light, faster flicker from the steam
lens_fx: rice grains smear onto the lens (fourth wall)
shots.character_action: scoops rice at double speed, chopsticks clacking against the bowl
shots.expression: pleading puppy eyes over bulging cheeks

props: rice grains on the T-shirt collar

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, I didn't steal it! This is carrying out a carbohydrate sampling mission!

overlays.text: Emergency Swallow Protocol Activated 3.2 times per second

shots.transition: whip pan following a flying rice grain

shots.visual: The camera stumbles back a step; DeepSeek Whale Maiden follows it, still stuffing rice in, bowl tilted toward the lens so the last grains slide in, cheeks round as a hamster's and rice grains stuck all over the collar of her T-shirt.
lens_fx: a few rice grains still stuck on the lens
shots.character_action: chases the camera one step while tipping the bowl into her mouth

props: rice grains on the T-shirt collar

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: You didn't see anything!! Cache cleaning! (unclear)

shots.transition: music hit, cut on her final swallow

shots.visual: DeepSeek Whale Maiden swallows the last mouthful and stands up straight facing the camera: two rice grains on her lips, whale fin accessory tilted, hands behind her back trying to look dignified, belly visibly bulging a little; she clears her throat and smiles.

camera.move: steady POV at eye level, tiny push-in

shots.lighting: warm light, she is centered and sharp, background blurred
shots.character_action: stands straight, hands behind her back, clears her throat
